thread:
devon: Heads up — planning the Clipper launch posts + a quick webinar next Thursday. Experiment idea: small cohort get 200 starter credits + a prompt template pack and an onboarding nudge series. Goal: measure 7-day activation and avg tokens/use. cc @anya @mike :mag_right:

anya: love it. can we split the cohort 3 ways? 1) credits-only, 2) credits + promptpack, 3) credits + promptpack + timed nudges. will help isolate lift. :thinking_face:

mike: sounds good. timeline wise we need creative by Tue and a segmented invite list by Wed. i can run the cohort split in Growth UI, need final segment rules.

olivia: copying the hypothesis into the brief: "prompt templates reduce time-to-first-success; nudges increase repeat usage." i'll add bench metrics: DAU/7-day, avg session tokens, prompt reuse rate. putting a doc here: https://redwood.company/s/clipper-launch-brief

devon: nice. mike — segment rules: new users in last 30 days who hit quickstart but not completed tutorial; exclude enterprise customers. size target: 3k total (1k per arm). can you confirm feasibility?

mike: feasible. will need to cap by region — prefer NA + EU only for this round. setting rollout windows to avoid overlap with other campaigns.

anya: creative notes: launch post series (3 cards) + 1-minute demo clip for webinar promo. messaging: "Get 200 starter credits + ready-to-use prompt packs to ship features faster." CTA -> sign up for Clipper webinar or try in console.

olivia: webinar plan: 30 min live demo (15min product, 10min tutorial on templates, 5min Q&A). signup page should collect workspace size and use-case for tailoring followups. recorded replay gated behind email + credit redemption.

devon: activation nudge cadence proposal: Day0 email with onboarding checklist + promptpack, Day1 in-app tooltip for first prompt, Day3 contextual tip based on usage, Day7 reward email with extra 100 credits if they complete 3 runs. any objections?

sophie: thumbs up. suggest we throttle the Day1 tooltip to only show once per workspace and have an opt-out for power users. also add an interstitial in SDK onboarding flow. :thumbsup:

mike: running the A/B will need experiment metadata: experiment_id=clipper_launch_v1, arms=[credits, credits+prompts, credits+prompts+nudge], metric_primary=7d_active_workspaces, metric_secondary=avg_tokens_per_active. will push to Growth console later today.

anya: creative ask to design: hero image + 3 cards + webinar banner + email hero + tooltip copy. deadline Tue EOD. ping me when assets are uploaded.

olivia: recording logistics — booking webinar room 11am PT Thu. can Sophie moderate? she'll run live Q&A and triage product questions.

sophie: happy to moderate. will prep 5 FAQs and coordinate with eng for fallback answers.

devon: marketing ops — can campaign-bot schedule the social posts for Thu 10am PT (pre-webinar) and replay post Fri 2pm?

campaign-bot: scheduled social post "Clipper Launch — demo + credits" for 2025-03-27T17:00:00Z and replay post for 2025-03-28T18:00:00Z. :white_check_mark:

mike: quick note on measurement — set up cohort tagging so we can attribute credit redemptions and promptpack installs to the experiment arm. i'll add a tracking spec in the doc.

anya: will also add UTM matrix for organic posts and paid promo to separate inbound traffic in analytics.

devon: sweet. next steps: anya — creative brief + assets by Tue, mike — cohort config + experiment push today, olivia — webinar page + recording slot, sophie — FAQ + moderation prep. i'll follow up w/ a snapshot on Wed. thanks everyone! :rocket:
